about.description:
lintegrate provides Python functions for numerical integration of functions
in log-space. This is useful for functions that have a very large dynamic
range, or intrinsically would include very large or small numbers, and
therefore it is more practical to work with the natural logarithm of the
function. In these cases it is useful to also stay within log-space when
integrating the function, which is what this package enables.

The functions provided by lintegrate are equivalent to, and based on,
several numerical integration routines provided within the GNU Scientific
Library (GSL).
about.summary: Python functions implementing numerical integration of functions in log-space.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.2.1"

package:
  name: lintegrate
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/l/lintegrate/lintegrate-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 8cea89e74f33211193636a48f83d1164bc595376794c89972d8554575e719208

build:
  dynamic_linking:
    overdepending_behavior: error
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  skip:
    - python_impl != 'cpython'

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    # extras for cross-compiling
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython
        - numpy
        - python
  host:
    - cython
    - gsl
    - numpy
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - setuptools_scm
  run:
    - python
  ignore_run_exports:
    by_name:
      - if: win
        then:
          - ucrt
          - vc14_runtime
          - vs2015_runtime

tests:
  - files:
      source:
        - test
    requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - pytest
    script:
      - python -m pip check
      - python -m pip show lintegrate
      - python -m pytest test -v -ra

about:
  summary: Python functions implementing numerical integration of functions in log-space.
  description: |
    lintegrate provides Python functions for numerical integration of functions
    in log-space. This is useful for functions that have a very large dynamic
    range, or intrinsically would include very large or small numbers, and
    therefore it is more practical to work with the natural logarithm of the
    function. In these cases it is useful to also stay within log-space when
    integrating the function, which is what this package enables.

    The functions provided by lintegrate are equivalent to, and based on,
    several numerical integration routines provided within the GNU Scientific
    Library (GSL).
  homepage: http://github.com/mattpitkin/lintegrate
  repository: https://github.com/mattpitkin/lintegrate.git
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - mattpitkin
